tools.name: find_or_quote_task
tools.description: Start here. Describe the desired result in ordinary language. PHION identifies the exact service, input schema, price ceiling and next call without charging or executing anything.

tools.name: authorize_and_execute_selected_task
tools.description: After find_or_quote_task selects a service, submit its input, an idempotency key and an explicit maximum atomic-USDC budget. The first call returns payment requirements without execution; an x402-aware client may obtain local approval and retry this identical MCP call with payment metadata. PHION ne

tools.name: verify_or_explain_result
tools.description: Verify a PHION receipt for free, or turn a structured failed status into one safe next action. This tool never charges, retries, or executes a provider.

tools.name: find_best_service_for_task
tools.description: Compatibility alias for find_or_quote_task. Free, advisory and non-executing.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "authorize_and_execute_selected_task" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
